notes.title: The Last update of Capsular
notes.content:
Hello Community!

I am very sad to announce that the next update will be the last content update. 
This is because i can no longer justify putting a ton of time into Capsular. Because lets face it. The game flopped. I am already working on a new project wich will hopefully do alot better then Capsular ever has. On my journey i met alot of really awesome people and i learned quite alot about how to handle and manage a commercial release! I hope i wont do the same mistakes again in the future.

What will happen now ? 
Well the next update will be the last content update. If bugs or crashes popup after the patch i will try to fix them as fast as possible. This also means that i am scrapping the campaign. This will also mean that the next patch will bring Capsular out of Early Access making it a finished product! 

What will the next patch include ?
Mostly stuff for Machine Uprising. This includes a brand new Map, Weapons, Enemies, Upgrades and even a new Boss! I also rebalanced alot of the old content making Machine Uprising alot more fun!

Does this mean your abandoning the game leaving it in its buggy state ? I try not to be THAT kind of developer. The game will release in a state where i can be proud of what i have achieved. If bugs, glitches and crashes popup after release i will fix them as fast as i can! So dont worry about it.

I would like to thank a few people who supported and helped me over the course of development:


 KingyKronus who helped me find problems and giving suggestions
 Junn3 & LAX3N for creating one of the first Capsular Content on youtube and helping me to create the trailer for the game.
 Jana for being a awesome human and supporting me with her amazing music and voice acting directing!
 199X Survivor Pro, Beef and Nintendawgz for breaking my game on a regular basis
 Sparktite, Simpli & Keepsake for supporting me and streaming the game
 And ofc all of my voice actors who helped to bring my weird announcers to life!


I hope you guys and girls will understand my decision to finally finish this game!

Stay neato,
Gunschlinger

notes.title: Capsular will go free to play!

Hello!

The community has spoken! Capsular will go free to play! But what does that mean for existing owners of the game?

Existing owners will receive the Indie Supporter DLC for FREE! 

But what is the Indie Supporter DLC ?
Its a $7 DLC you can buy once the game goes free to play. The DLC will give you 20000 Ingame gold (Enough for 2 Outstanding Hats!) and a Unique Supporter Weapon Skin for all weapons. The Free to play launch will include a new patch.

notes.title: Should Capsular be free to play ?
notes.content:
Hello! 

Since Capsular released the game has always struggled with its player numbers. They are well... very very low. I had the idea of making this game free to play for quite a while now but i always didnt do it since some people already spend good money for it. Now i have decided it would be the best to let my small community decide. 

Should the game go free to play ?
Please use this poll: https://www.strawpoll.me/16933704

If the game would become free to play and you guys would like to get some kind of reward for buying the game early i would make a 7€ dlc wich includes a bunch of ingame gold and maybe a free skin or two. All owners of Capsular would receive this dlc for free. When the game does go free to play i will keep the buisness model the same. No Pay to win. No Paid cosmetics. You will only be able to buy the very optional 7€ dlc just to support me. All future updates will be free aswell. If the poll is successfull then i will make the game free to play in a week or two. 

Thank you for your support !

-Gunschlinger

notes.title: The Future content of Capsular
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31457392/4106a2d71528108ee5e6fa25961c03549bf876d5.png
Hi! I wanted to talk today about the future content of Capsular. Since the free weekend event went not as expected and the playercount is still very low i have decided to focus the main chunk of my time, to implement more singleplayer / coop content into the game. Over the upcomming weeks i will release a public beta branch. This beta branch will get much more updates then usually. Please keep in mind that builds on the beta branch are unstable.

Hideout
The Hideout is a player housing system that allows you do decorate your own apartment however you want! Coop missions will sometimes drop random trophys that you can hang in your apartment. The hideout is designed as the endgame of Capsular. Its a place you can hangout with your friends and have some good old fun or to just brag!

Coop Campaign
I am also working on a coop campaign. Wich will develop the story of Capsular a bit more. The coop missions can be played alone or with up to 3 friends. More on that soon! The first Campaign will be split into single missions wich will roll out over time. Stay tuned for more information!

Future Arena FPS content
Unfortunatly the next few updates wont have any new content for the Arena FPS gamemode. I will still do balance and bug fixes here and there tho. 

Future Modding
I plan to implement modding into the game. Modding will propably be released before or after the full games launch. My plan is to allow everyone to make new maps for ANY gamemode. But you can also implement more coop enemies, weapons, cosmetics and furniture for the hideout. 

I hope you guys will understand my change in direction. I came to the conclusion that working on a pure Arena FPS isnt a good idea since there are other WAY more polished games in the genre and i simply cant compete with them.

If you have questions or general feedback then PLEASE contact me over  Discord,  Twitter or by adding me over Steam!

-Gunschlinger

notes.content:

Welcome to the 13th Capsular Development Blog. This week i worked on a First Win of the Day system, A Server notification system, Playerslot system and i added Playericons to the scoreboard and round end.

First Win of the Day:
I added a first win of the day system wich will grant bonus gold and exp if you win a round in Capsular. I made it so i can tweak the bonus gold and exp values inside by backend system, so balancing how much bonus gold and exp the players get should be very easy. The way it works is that once you login you will see a notification underneath your steam avatar if you have your first win of the day available. After you used your first win of the day the bonus will be locked for 24h indicated by a timer. I hope this system will encourage players to play atleast 1 round of Capsular daily.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31457392/771dc20171f4da3d59d8afcfa91604a29049171b.jpg

Servermessages:
I made it posible for me to display global server messages. So if a patch is causing problems i can prevent everyone from playing the game. Or notify the players that a feature is broken and a hotfix is on the way.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31457392/c37de04de6e95b35dd2c700970fea70cb828c417.jpg

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31457392/4bd271ac4d57ee155fb045dca28239dc32bc69d2.jpg

Playerslots:
I increased the number of bots you can have on a server. The new max is now 11 bots. If you set your Max Player slots to 12 you will be able to add 11 bots. Players always have a higher priority then bots. So if a player joins a server 1 bot will get kicked. If the player leaves again the bot will rejoin. So now you can host games with a lot of bots in it without the game dying. I also fixed that you can have more bots on the server then there are slots on the server.

Playericons:
I added little icons to each player inside the scoreboard. The icon background color will change based on the color of the player. The icon will always show the currently equiped cosmetic. This makes it more easy to identify players on the server.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31457392/8b024f2e435d60ab2b1f35911acee9503eaa3f5a.jpg
Even bots got icons!


I am sorry for this rather short development blog. I hope that i can show more next week.

That's it for this week! Make sure to follow the game on  Twitter! Also checkout the new  IndieDB page if you have some time. Until next week!

Welcome to the 9th Capsular Development Blog. Ive got a lot of feedback from my playtesters so i got lots to show.

This week marks the end of the 2 week Capsular Open Beta.

Overview:

Walljumping
Map Changes
Colored Crosshair
Beta Feedback
New Cosmetics


Walljumping:
This week i added Walljumping to Capsular. Walljumping enables you to jump off a wall to gain height and to suprise your enemies. You can perform a Walljump by pressing Jump while in the air near a wall.

https://media.giphy.com/media/8FMMJq4TeiyHLtMysq/giphy.gif

Map Changes:
There were quite some changes to Thundercreek and Lab based on Beta Feedback. 

I simplified the upper Shotgun pickup spawn	to improve visibility and navigation. 
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31457392/985ba5e8b3d6c324804294b0829669c38fa01b6f.png

Additionaly i chopped down some Trees because players kept getting stuck in them.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31457392/84c173b75029cad380e865a6934ae78fce8a3b52.png

In Lab i changed the pit in the Factory area a bit to make it more clear that you will die if you fall into it. I added Toxic Waste and Barrels to the area. I also added a Geigercounter ambient effect to the area to make it more clear whats going on.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31457392/1bfa8fe6e0da78635ecda3d5ae229fd1cb11eb44.png

Colored Crosshair:
I added the ability to change the crosshair color of each weapon.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31457392/79da33dec5f3dd555de1d5375d5abc2e38093eef.png

Beta Feedback:
Now i got quite a lot of Beta Feedback these 2 weeks. I changed the volume of your own footstep sounds to be a bit more quiet since some people thought it was too loud. I also added the Ability to cancel your Slide midslide. You can choose to cancel the slide by releasing the slide key or by pressing the slide key again (Changeable in the Settings menu).

New Cosmetics:
I added a new TVHead cosmetic into the game. This Cosmetic is of Outstanding(Legendary) Quality and changes expression based on what your doing.
https://media.giphy.com/media/3D2IcAj1MfDWoKHnkd/giphy.gif

https://media.giphy.com/media/3eRonxqKZMwaAU8y68/giphy.gif

Thanks to everyone who checked out the Capsular Open Beta. 
Special Thanks to:

199X Survivor Pro, DeefTheMegaWeeb, LapisLoserli, 12hoursOfDarkness and Nintendawgz for providing excellent feedback and suggestions.
KingyGamer for helping me debug the game.
Junn3,Sparktite,AbbyTheBunny,Q and Gayboi for streaming Capsular.


All of you will keep your key and some will be promoted to Playtester if you want. 
YOU GUYS ROCK!



That's it for this week! Make sure to follow the game on  Twitter! Also checkout the new  IndieDB page if you have some time. Until next week!
